What is counted: rules that pay a share of a firm's bill for rented or bought computing; most are called computing vouchers (算力券) or a like name, and 38 of the counted rules give the payment another name, a subsidy, a reward or support (Anhui, Changzhou, Chaoyang (Beijing), Datong, Fengtai, Fujian, Futian, Fuzhou, Guangzhou Development Zone and Huangpu, Haidian, Hebei, Hefei High-tech Zone, Hongshan, Huainan, Inner Mongolia, Jiaxing, Langfang, Lingang, Lucheng, Minhang, Nanchang High-tech Zone, Nansha, Putuo (Shanghai), Quanzhou, Quzhou, Shaoguan, Shijingshan, Songjiang, Suzhou, Suzhou Industrial Park, Tianfu New Area, Tianhe, Wuchang, Xiamen, Xinjiang, Xuhui, Zhengzhou Airport Zone, Zhengzhou High-tech Zone). These are the rules found by searches that went province by province and city by city, saved and read, not a census of every local government: the searches covered the 31 province-level governments, 24 named cities and new areas, and the cities, districts and zones on the lists of four searches that went city by city; other districts and counties only as they turned up. Counted 90: 7 pay more for home-made computing and still pay for other computing (Binjiang, Chengdu, Hubei, Longwan and Wenzhou Bay New Area, Wenzhou, Wuhan, Zhejiang); 4 pay for home-made computing only (Changsha Economic and Technological Development Zone, Huangyan, Ningbo, Sichuan); 79 state no higher rate for home-made computing: 78 of them pay one rate whatever the chip, and 1, Hangzhou's, pays 30% or 20% by a type of computing facility that it does not name (its repealed measures paid 30% for home-made and 20% for other facilities). Read and not counted 147. Of the 90, 50 are read on an official page or file of the issuing government or body and 40 in another copy (another government's or body's site, a news or commercial site, or an Internet Archive capture: Anhui, Binhaiwan New Area (Dongguan), Binjiang, Changsha Economic and Technological Development Zone, Chaoyang (Beijing), Chengdu, Chengdu High-tech Zone, Foshan, Futian, Guangming, Guizhou, Hangzhou, Hebei, Hebei District (Tianjin), Hefei High-tech Zone, Hubei, Inner Mongolia, Jiangxi, Langfang, Longwan and Wenzhou Bay New Area, Nanchang High-tech Zone, Nanning, Ningbo, Putuo (Shanghai), Qiantang, Qingdao, Quzhou, Shandong, Shanxi, Sichuan, Suqian, Suzhou Industrial Park, Tianfu New Area, Tianjin, Wuchang, Xiamen, Zhangzhou, Zhengzhou Airport Zone, Zhongkai High-tech Zone (Huizhou), Zhuhai). Other ways of counting, each computed by the same script: Hangzhou read as paying more for home-made computing, 90 / 8 / 4 / 78; Hangzhou left out, 89 / 7 / 4 / 78; without the 33 rules of the searches of Nov 25, 2026 that give the payment another name (Changzhou, Chaoyang (Beijing), Datong, Fengtai, Fujian, Futian, Fuzhou, Haidian, Hebei, Hefei High-tech Zone, Huainan, Inner Mongolia, Jiaxing, Langfang, Lingang, Lucheng, Minhang, Nanchang High-tech Zone, Nansha, Putuo (Shanghai), Quanzhou, Quzhou, Shaoguan, Shijingshan, Songjiang, Suzhou Industrial Park, Tianfu New Area, Tianhe, Wuchang, Xiamen, Xuhui, Zhengzhou Airport Zone, Zhengzhou High-tech Zone), 57 / 7 / 4 / 46; without all 38 such rules, 52 / 7 / 4 / 41; with every judgment call taken the narrow way (Beijing city, Changzhou, Chaoyang (Beijing), Datong, Fengtai, Fujian, Futian, Fuzhou, Haidian, Hangzhou, Hebei, Hefei High-tech Zone, Huainan, Inner Mongolia, Jiangsu, Jiaxing, Langfang, Lingang, Lucheng, Minhang, Nanchang High-tech Zone, Nansha, Ningbo, Putuo (Shanghai), Quanzhou, Quzhou, Shaoguan, Shijingshan, Songjiang, Suzhou Industrial Park, Tianfu New Area, Tianhe, Wuchang, Xiamen, Xuhui, Zhengzhou Airport Zone, Zhengzhou High-tech Zone left out), 53 / 7 / 3 / 43 (each line: counted / pay more for home-made / home-made only / no higher rate for home-made). Columns: row_id (A = local_vouchers.tsv, B = local_vouchers_more.tsv, numbered in the file's order) | government | class (for a rule of the third class, its kind: one rate, or two rates by a type of computing facility that the rule does not name) | reason (for a row not counted: the part of the rule it fails) | deciding_words (for a counted rule: the row's rate words, found by script in the saved copy, whose sentence and rates decide the class; for a row not counted: the row's own words cell) | saved_id (the copy read). Made by script from the two tables and the saved copies; do not edit by hand. One reason differs from the label first given (row B36, Longgang's measures of December 2024: a rule since repealed or revised, since Longgang has no counted rule). Ningbo's rule is classed by its contract condition, read beside its rate sentence, which names no home-made computing itself. The rules of Binhaiwan New Area and Haidian are classed at one rate with listed words taken out of their rate sentences: home-made computing named only as a service paid at the same rate (adapting to home-made systems and chips), or only as an encouragement with no rate of its own. Shenyang's rule is classed at one rate on its own text, which names no origin, supplier, centre or list; the provincial data bureau's replies, another body's account, describe the two cities' vouchers in four sentences that do not agree, only one of them as a limit to home-made computing (row B103 gives the four).
